about_desc: A free, open-source VPN client using VPN Gate, Tor, Stealth and optional WARP.

auto_sub: Picks the fastest free server for you
consent_body:
This app uses Android VpnService to create an encrypted tunnel for all device traffic. This is its core function.

Traffic is routed through third-party volunteer servers (VPN Gate, University of Tsukuba), the Tor network, or Cloudflare WARP. Those operators may log connection metadata. Use HTTPS for sensitive data.

PathGuard does not collect, log, or sell browsing data, DNS queries, or traffic contents.

Ads are shown by Google AdMob. Ad requests are not modified or redirected for monetization.
err_free_busy: Free servers busy — tap to retry or use Stealth/WARP
err_no_free_servers: No free server available right now
exclude_apps_sub: Exclude banking apps so they use your normal connection
faq_a1: Free servers are run by volunteers and come and go. Tap Connect again, pick another country, or switch to Stealth or WARP. Smart Connect in Settings switches to Stealth automatically.
faq_a2: Free: quick everyday use. Tor: more anonymity, but slower. Stealth: for networks that block VPNs. WARP: fast and stable, without a country choice.
faq_a3: Speed depends on the volunteer server and its distance. Pick a server with a low ping (green number) or try WARP. Use Tools → Speed test to compare.
faq_a4: Watch one short video to turn off ads for 6 hours. Each video adds 6 more hours, up to 24 hours.
faq_a5: PathGuard keeps no logs of your activity. Free servers are run by third parties who may log connections, so don't use them for banking. For more privacy, use Tor or WARP.
faq_q1: The app doesn't connect. What can I do?
